questions.question: The main aim of Frankston Connect is to

analyses.content: 录音明确说明俱乐部的目标是为有相似兴趣和想法的人提供社交接触，这对应了选项A的“结交志同道合的人”。
录音中虽然提到了“健身（fitness）”和“慈善（charity）”，但前面都有明显的否定词，你在听题时千万不要只抓取原词，而忽略了前后的否定语境。

Okay, so what are our club aims? We're not a fitness club or anything like that. Some Connect branches do charity work, but that's not for us. Our objective is to provide social contact with others who have similar interests and ideas.

options.option: The members planned a trip to a foreign country.
options.optionContent: The members planned a trip to a foreign country.

questions.question: What happened at last month's meeting?

analyses.content: 录音提到上个月的会议讨论了那个月花了多少钱，完美对应选项A的“讨论俱乐部财务”。
录音虽然提到有人刚从海外旅行回来，以及摄影比赛的获胜者很快会公布，但这些要么是个别成员的分享，要么是未来发生的事，你可能会因为听到零星干扰词而选错，一定要注意听清动作时态和会议的核心议题。

Now, meetings. We have monthly club meetings where the usual club business is discussed. For example, at the last meeting, we talked about how much money was spent that month. Also, at that meeting, someone had just returned from an overseas trip, and he spoke about that. Then we looked at entries for our photography competition. The winner will be announced soon.

questions.question: The venue for the monthly meetings will change because the school hall is

analyses.content: 录音中提到学校大厅即将被翻新，所以需要找个替代地点，这说明大厅现在不能用了，对应选项C。
录音提到过去的大厅尺寸很大且很容易到达，这恰好直接排除了选项A和B，你千万不要把场地过去的优点当成了现在需要更换的原因。

Up until now, we've used the school hall for our meetings, but that's about to be renovated, so we needed to find an alternative. It's been a great venue because of its size, and it's so easy to get to, but I'm sure historical Frankston Hall will suit us just fine.

questions.question: The Social Committee would like members to

analyses.content: 录音指出社交委员会一直在寻找成员关于新去处的建议，这直接对应选项C的“提供未来活动的点子”。
录音明确说是委员会自己计划和组织活动，并没有要求成员帮忙组织，你在听的时候要准确抓取委员会对成员的期待其实是给出“建议（suggestions）”。
Our social committee plans and organizes club trips from time to time, and they're always looking for suggestions from members for new places to go to.

options.option: pay for two people or more.
options.optionContent: pay for two people or more.

questions.question: How can you save money on members' fees?

analyses.content: 录音明确说到年度付款（annual payment）是一个稍微便宜一点的选择，这对应了选项B的“付一年的钱”。
录音前面提到了今天上午填表交钱，后面提到了也可以按月付款，你可能会将今天交表或普通的付款方式跟“省钱”混淆，做题时必须精准锁定“更便宜（cheaper）”所对应的具体条件。

So how do you join, and what about membership fees? It's simple. Just fill in the form and give it to me before you leave this morning. There are a few payment options. Some members prefer to make an annual payment, which is a slightly cheaper option, or you can pay monthly.

groups.contentHtml:
EVENTS
16. Moonlight Wildlife Walk
17. Theatre in the park
18. Bird-watching
19. Botanical Gardens Walk
20. State Library

analyses.content: 录音提到虽然活动免费，但要求成员向野生动物基金支付一点钱，这对应了选项E的“要求捐助资金”。
听到“免费（free）”时你可能会觉得完全不需要花钱，但紧跟着的“支付一点钱（pay something）”才是真实的考点，做题时不要被前半句的让步状语迷惑。

If you still haven't decided whether to join or not, let me try to tempt you with some of our upcoming events. Our Moonlight Wildlife Walk was previously available to members' immediate families as well, but this wonderful activity has become so popular that it's now limited to just members. Although it's free, we do ask our members to pay something to the wildlife fund so it can continue its good work. Everyone makes their way to the wildlife park independently, arriving at dusk, where a guide walks with the group and tells us about all the animals we encounter.
录音中提到有些成员喜欢带自己的座位（take along their own seat），这同义替换了选项G的“可以带椅子”。
录音说不需要预订，直接排除了选项A，你听到“预订（reservation）”这个词时一定要注意前面的否定表达“没必要（no need）”。

Okay, Theater in the Park. We see a different play every month. The park's on the train line and easy to access, so we don't organize buses or anything. Come along and recline on a blanket on the grass. Although some members prefer to take along their own seat. No need to make a reservation, there's plenty of space.
录音提到会有热心成员开着俱乐部的面包车（club van）载大家去最好的地点，这对应了选项H的“俱乐部提供交通工具”。
这道题干扰信息较少，你容易犯的错误是没有第一时间把录音里的“在俱乐部面包车里载成员”和选项里的“提供交通工具”迅速联系起来。

Bird watching is a regular activity, and it's organized by the keen bird watchers in the club. This activity consists mainly of early morning and late afternoon walking trips to spot the birds when they're most active. Bird watching attracts only small numbers, so one of our ardent bird watchers drives members in the club van to the best spots.
录音说明很多成员会带朋友或亲戚来且这没问题，这就说明了选项D的“欢迎非成员参加”。
录音中明确提到成员们需要自己前往目的地，如果你还在等上一题的“提供交通”选项，这里刚好是反向信息，做匹配题时要顺着新的音频进度走，不要跟丢了。

The City Botanical Gardens walk is a popular activity that occurs a couple of times a year. Members make their own way there and usually meet up outside the gates at eight forty-five AM, setting off for the hour's walk with the volunteer guide by nine AM. Many members bring a friend or relative, and this is fine.
录音提到会在那里的小电影院看一部关于当地历史的短片（short film），这对应了选项F的“放映纪录片”。
录音中提到了餐厅并且可以带食物进去，你可能会因此错选选项C（提供免费零食），但录音并没有说是免费提供食物，听题时要警惕这种只沾边一半的错误干扰项。

Now, the State Library. Our visits here in the past have always been great because there's something for everyone. You can easily spend a whole day in there. There's a lovely restaurant, and you can take food into the small cinema there, where we'll be watching a short film about the history of our local area.
